messages:
Elena Soto: Quick question  I need to remove my ex-partner from benefits effective 2026-04-30. Separation was finalized then but I didn't notify immediately. What's the process and can COBRA be offered retroactively?
Samira Khan: Sorry to hear that, Elena. For dependent removals due to separation, we treat it as a QLE if there's a legal event. Please upload supporting docs (separation agreement or court order) to the secure portal and indicate desired termination date. Link: https://hr.redwood.com/secure-upload
Samira Khan: COBRA note: COBRA qualifying event date is usually the date of loss of coverage (your requested termination date). We notify carriers/TPA once docs are uploaded. COBRA notices will be generated and mailed by the carrier/COBRA vendor; we can't force retro COBRA earlier than the carrier's legal timelines.
Elena Soto: I don't have a court order, only a signed separation agreement and proof of separate residence (utility bills). Will that work? I discovered the separation paperwork late.
BenefitsAdmin: Separation agreement + proof of address for the ex-partner can be sufficient for initial processing. We may ask for additional attestation. Upload those docs and choose "Dependent Removal (QLE)". If you missed a filing window we can request carrier exception but it's carrier-dependent.
Elena Soto: Uploaded as "1799000001_elena_sep_packet.pdf" (separation agreement + 2 utility bills) to the portal.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: do NOT post PII in channels. Use secure upload: https://hr.redwood.com/secure-upload.
Samira Khan: Got the upload, thanks. We'll start the termination and trigger COBRA vendor notification. Expect the vendor to send initial COBRA packet within 7-10 business days. If you want the dependent removed from payroll deductions immediately, let PayrollOps know.
PayrollOps: We can stop deductions prospectively the next payroll run once termination is finalized. For retro premium refunds, carriers rarely grant retro refunds; if a refund is possible we'll coordinate. If COBRA is elected, premium billing typically starts from the COBRA effective date set by the vendor.
Elena Soto: Thanks. Please confirm when COBRA packet is sent. I may need the notice for a bank/process I'm dealing with.
BenefitsAdmin: We will update here when vendor confirms mailing. If you need an interim statement, we can provide a confirmation email showing we've submitted the QLE and requested COBRA initiation.
Elena Soto: Appreciate it.
Samira Khan: We'll follow up in this thread once vendor responds.
